title: Grocery List
description: Aggregated grocery list assembled from one or more archived recipes. Generated by the grocery-list skill via `just list`. Stored at ~/Documents/grocery-list.<unix-timestamp>.yaml alongside the markdown and HTML companion files.

generated.description: ISO 8601 datetime (local time zone, with offset) when the list was generated.

unix_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds since epoch — identical to the value used in the file basename (grocery-list.<unix_timestamp>.yaml).

recipes.description: The recipes whose ingredients were aggregated into this list, in the order the user selected them.

title.description: Display title of the recipe (matches the title field in the recipe's recipe.yaml).

slug.description: Title-Case-Kebab directory name under recipes/, e.g. 'Slow-Cooker-Chicken-Cacciatore'.

url.description: Original source URL of the recipe (taken from the recipe.yaml's url field).

archive_url.description: GitHub blob URL for the archived index.html (e.g., https://github.com/<user>/<repo>/blob/main/recipes/<slug>/index.html). Null if the project has no GitHub remote or the remote URL couldn't be parsed.

items.description: Flat list of ingredient lines across all selected recipes. Order is preserved from each recipe's ingredients block (main group first, then named subsections like 'For Serving'). Items are NOT deduplicated across recipes — if two recipes both call for 'butter', both lines appear independently.

recipe.description: Display title of the recipe this item came from. Must match one of recipes[].title.

section.description: Section name within the recipe (e.g., 'For Serving'); null for the default/main ingredient group.

text.description: Ingredient line verbatim from the source recipe (measurements, units, descriptors, prep notes all preserved).
